reviewer: Coordinating author plus separate equity and valuation specialist
scope: Four original worked cases/eight solved exercises with exact lab/checker. Positive market state-price replication, separate physical owner criterion, funded operating menu, staged gate and joint-signal information decisions tested.
source_review: Root and independent peer inspected actual scoped MIT, NYU and Duke source bodies; original derivations and cases independently recomputed. No whole-source endorsement or current-market observation claimed.

resolved_findings.finding: The initial traded-clone lab accepted physical_up equal to zero or one despite its both-states-possible contract and strictly positive market state prices.
resolved_findings.author_resolution: Added 0 < physical_up < 1 only to the traded market case, documented it in the guide and added both endpoint rejection checks. Owner probabilities and signal likelihoods retain their valid closed-unit-interval boundaries.
resolved_findings.peer_verification: Read the final code/guide/checker/author changes and independently tested both endpoint rejections plus valid owner certainty and unreachable signals. Original manuscript and reference numerical output are unchanged.

limitations: Agent review is not external human certification or validation of a real investment.
